title: Visitor archetype registry (the §3.2 patience spine)
description: Shape of packages/content/visitors/*.json. Structural shell for the §8.18 visual-coverage law (OD-12(d), ADR-0013 ruling 5d): every archetype carries a `visual` slug — the §3.1 duration-class primitive unless §3.2/§3.3 names a distinct render — or an explicit codexOnly tag. `lookalikeOf` is deliberately NOT declared here: the direction law (§2.4/OD-18) is threat-masks-visitor, never the reverse, and script/validate.mjs fails an archetype carrying it red. Legacy required keys and bounty/_todo discipline also live in validate.mjs. Interpreter subset in use: type, required, properties, items, enum, pattern, minimum, maxItems.
